D1 behavior unchanged: readChangeVerificationStatus returns undefined → gate unavailable → verification-facts-unavailable (canRun rejects, next blocks), identical surface to 091; only the forward-compat not-applicable branch is corrected from wrong-block to correct-release. typecheck/build/lint/test(424)/openspec strict all pass. consistencyScan 9 dimensions, 0 contradictions. Next action: review-apply.

findingsAddressed.title: not-applicable Verification is incorrectly blocked as not-run
findingsAddressed.rootCause: src/policy/verification-gate.ts mapVerificationStatusToGate (091) mapped not-applicable and not-run to the same {kind:'not-run'} branch, with a comment 'fail-closed: not passed, no dedicated reason'. verificationGateUnmet then returned 'verification-not-run' and verificationGateDiagnosis returned verificationNotRunDiagnosis, so canRun(review-apply)/canRun(archive) rejected and next() blocked with verification-not-run whenever a future snapshot carried not-applicable. This diverges from frozen verification-model.md Section 3.3 (review-apply requires passed|not-applicable) and delivery-lifecycle.md Section 3.4/3.5 (archive accepts passed|not-applicable). not-applicable is the explicit 'no applicable check' satisfied state, not a blocked state. The D1 Proposal spec/design/tasks repeated a passed-only restriction, so the active Change contract and implementation diverged from the frozen lifecycle in the same direction.
findingsAddressed.fix: verification-gate.ts: VerificationGateResult kind 'passed' → 'satisfied' (semantics: passed OR not-applicable); mapVerificationStatusToGate maps passed → satisfied and not-applicable → satisfied (not-applicable no longer fail-closed to not-run); verificationGateUnmet satisfied → null; NonPassedVerificationGate renamed NonSatisfiedVerificationGate (Exclude<...,{kind:'satisfied'}>); comments cite frozen verification-model.md Section 3.3 and delivery-lifecycle.md Section 3.4/3.5. next.ts: decideApplyStage !lineage.match and approved branches vGate.kind !== 'passed' → vGate.kind !== 'satisfied'. preconditions.ts: three comments updated to 'Only satisfied (passed or not-applicable) satisfies' (logic unchanged — verificationGateUnmet already returns null for satisfied). blocked-diagnosis.ts: verificationNotRunDiagnosis comment drops 'or not-applicable, fail-closed' and states not-applicable does NOT map here. verification-gate.test.ts: passed → satisfied; not-applicable → satisfied (D1-RA-003); new 'passed and not-applicable both release the gate' test; exhaustive + verificationGateUnmet kind lists updated. spec.md/tasks.md/design.md: Change-Verification gate clauses 'passed' → 'passed or not-applicable' (review-apply/archive only); FullTestStatus passed (D1-12) untouched.
findingsAddressed.verificationEvidence: verification-gate.ts: mapVerificationStatusToGate case 'passed': case 'not-applicable': return {kind:'satisfied'}. verification-gate.test.ts: 'not-applicable → satisfied (D1-RA-003)'; 'passed and not-applicable both release the gate' asserts verificationGateUnmet === null for both. next.ts:229,242 if (vGate.kind !== 'satisfied'). preconditions.ts logic unchanged — verificationGateUnmet(evaluateVerificationGate(snapshot)) returns null only when satisfied, so canRun still rejects in D1 (gate always unavailable). 424/424 tests pass. In D1 the gate is always unavailable → verification-facts-unavailable (canRun/next), identical to 091 surface; only forward-compat not-applicable is corrected to release.
